Immutable address of the Loan contract this CollateralLocker is attached to.

Constructor parameter holding the collateral asset token address.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter _collateralAsset is written into the immutable state variable collateralAsset.
Constructor parameter _loan is written into the immutable state variable loan.
Constructor execution initializes collateralAsset state variable.
Constructor execution initializes loan state variable.
The stored loan address is read in the isLoan modifier to authorize the caller.
msg.sender is compared against loan in the isLoan modifier, the only access-control gate.
The isLoan modifier guards entry into pull, reverting on unauthorized callers.
pull invokes the external collateralAsset.safeTransfer operation on the token contract.
The collateralAsset state variable supplies the token contract targeted by the external transfer.
Untrusted dst parameter flows into the external transfer recipient, giving an attacker-controlled call target.
amt parameter flows into the external transfer value executed on the token.
safeTransfer forwards to Address.functionCall, a low-level call that transfers control to the token contract and may re-enter before state is settled.
pull's external token interaction ultimately reaches the low-level callback, allowing the callee to re-enter pull.
